tasks.subject: Map native Vita loading call chain
tasks.description: Inspect existing Vita3K SELF/ELF/VELF loaders, module metadata parsing, imports/NIDs/stubs, process and main-thread setup, memory mapping, CPU handoff, and HLE dispatch. Record exact files and dependencies.
tasks.activeForm: Mapping the native Vita loading call chain

tasks.subject: Audit browser blockers and fixtures
tasks.description: Trace dependencies that prevent reusing the native loader in the browser target, and search repository tests/assets/scripts for redistributable real Vita homebrew fixtures or generation infrastructure. Do not fabricate a fixture.
tasks.activeForm: Auditing browser blockers and available fixtures

tasks.subject: Design narrow reusable loader slice
tasks.description: Based on the loader audit, define the smallest existing Vita3K code slice that can be adapted for browser execution without parallel loader/linker logic or native frontend dependencies.
tasks.activeForm: Designing the reusable Vita loader slice

tasks.subject: Obtain real Vita homebrew fixture
tasks.description: Populate or provide a redistributable real VitaSDK-generated ELF/VELF fixture (or enable the existing VitaSDK toolchain/submodule) so the next browser slice can validate actual Vita module metadata, imports, and HLE handoff without fabricating an image.
tasks.activeForm: Obtaining a real Vita homebrew fixture

tasks.subject: Map native CPU and thread contracts
tasks.description: Inspect CPUState, CPUInterface, cpu::init_cpu, ThreadState initialization/run loop, and MemState/Ptr dependencies; document the narrowest convergence seam before editing.

tasks.subject: Add interpreter CPU backend seam
tasks.description: Implement the smallest backend-selection refactor preserving Dynarmic defaults and adapting the browser/test interpreter to the real Vita3K CPU contract where feasible.
tasks.activeForm: Adding the interpreter CPU backend seam

tasks.subject: Create MemState ThreadState regression
tasks.description: Add a controlled synchronous regression using real Vita3K MemState and ThreadState abstractions, executing ARM/Thumb code through the interpreter and normal SVC/stop event path without fake Vita imports.

tasks.subject: Build and validate runtime convergence
tasks.description: Keep all existing memory/interpreter/guest/ELF/browser tests passing, run native and Emscripten builds, and verify the new real-runtime regression and SVC stop behavior.

tasks.subject: Audit MemState host boundary
tasks.description: Classify mem::init responsibilities and inspect all memory/protection/Ptr users and browser build constraints to design the smallest native-versus-Wasm host backing seam.

tasks.subject: Implement browser MemState backing
tasks.description: Add a browser/Emscripten host backing path for real MemState using linear-memory-compatible storage and metadata permissions, preserving native mmap/VirtualAlloc behavior by default.

tasks.subject: Add real runtime convergence tests
tasks.description: Create focused MemState + CPUState + InterpreterCPU and cooperative ThreadState execution tests, proving MOV/MOVS and SVC state reach the existing ThreadState boundary without fake imports.

tasks.subject: Validate browser and native configurations
tasks.description: Run existing browser tests, new runtime tests, Emscripten build, and native/default configuration checks; distinguish missing submodules from implementation failures.

tasks.subject: Restore required external submodules
tasks.description: Inspect .gitmodules and repository submodule state, then initialize the minimal dependencies needed to configure/build the CPU, memory, and kernel convergence targets if network access permits.

tasks.subject: Identify native build dependency subset
tasks.description: Determine which external packages the native configuration requires and whether a focused partial initialization is sufficient for CPU/MemState validation.

tasks.subject: Reconfigure and validate native build
tasks.description: After dependencies are restored, reconfigure native and interpreter-backend builds, compile focused targets, and report any remaining dependency or source failures precisely.
tasks.activeForm: Reconfiguring and validating the native build
